div.head: Wi 23[b]
div.ab: gif he huslgenga nis, hæbbe him in aþe oðirne æwdan godne oþþe gelde oþþe selle to swinganne.
Gif he huslgenga nis, hæbbe him in aþe oðirne æwdan godne, oþþe gelde, oþþe selle to swinganne.
If he is not a communicant, he should have for himself in the oath another good oath-helper, or he should pay recompense, or he should give [his servant] to be flogged.
If he is not a communicant he shall get a second good witness [to support him] in the oath, or pay [the fine] or deliver him up to be scourged.
wenn derselbe nicht Abendmahlsgänger ist, so nehme er sich zum Eide einen zweiten guten Eideshelfer oder zahle [das Eingeklagte und Busse] oder liefere [ihn dem Kläger] aus zum Geisseln.
if he is not a communicant, let him take a second good oath-helper for the oath, or pay [the amount claimed and compensation], or hand [him over to the plaintiff] to be flogged.
